column1: # 超級馬力歐兄弟 驚奇（Switch，基礎版 v0 與更新 1.2.1）的遊戲檔案。本目錄另有著色器表（shader_split.py 生成）、c1_full.tsv、pso_manifest.tsv 與翻譯鏈版本頭 dmsh_chain.h

# Game profile of Super Mario Bros. Wonder (Switch, base game v0 and update 1.2.1). This folder also holds the shader tables (generated by shader_split.py), c1_full.tsv, pso_manifest.tsv and the chain version header dmsh_chain.h
# 格式：鍵 <TAB> 值；一個鍵多個值用空格分隔；build 每版一行；注釋只能獨佔一行。改內存 / NVN 常數後重編宿主；改著色器相關的鍵後按 AGENTS.md 走翻譯鏈流程

# Format: key <TAB> value; several values of one key are separated by spaces; one build row per version; comments must be on their own line. Rebuild the host after changing memory / NVN constants; after changing shader-related keys follow the chain procedure in AGENTS.md
# 遊戲名不寫在這裡：NSP 腳本從 NSP 的控制數據（NACP）取 | the game name is not kept here: the NSP script takes it from the NSP's control data (NACP)
# svcGetInfo(ProgramId) 報給遊戲的值（運行時 DM_PROGRAM_ID 可改） | the value svcGetInfo(ProgramId) reports to the game (DM_PROGRAM_ID overrides it at run time)
# 遊戲名：只給檔案列表與 Mac 窗口標題當標籤；iOS App 名取基礎版 NSP 裡的遊戲名，包名按基礎版標題號（build_ipa.sh / NSP 腳本）

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# build <版本> <顯示版本> <模塊>=<構建號>…：NSP 腳本只認這些構建（寫死的地址在別的構建上不成立）；宿主按 main 的構建號報顯示版本

# build <version> <display version> <module>=<build ID>...: the NSP script accepts only these builds (fixed addresses do not hold on other builds); the host reports the display version by main's build ID
# 缺省打進 IPA 的版本 | version packed into the IPA by default
# 著色器表是這幾個版本的並集（基礎版在前）：出包時這些版本都要有 | the shader tables are the union of these versions (base game first): all of them are needed to build
# 改寫並裝載的代碼模塊（裝載順序；rtld 由宿主代替） | code modules rewritten and loaded (load order; rtld is replaced by the host)
# RomFS 裡必須有的路徑（認遊戲文件放對了沒有） | a path that must exist in the RomFS (tells whether the game files are in the right place)
# zip 時不再壓縮的擴展名（本身已壓縮） | extensions zip stores without compressing (already compressed)
# ---- 內存（hle_svc.c；分區依據見那裡的注釋） | Memory (hle_svc.c; the reasons for the partition are in its comments) ----
# ---- NVN 驅動常量段（dmsh_build.py 出包、nvn_mtl.m 運行時現填；按全庫著色器實測） | NVN driver constant segments (dmsh_build.py at packaging, nvn_mtl.m filled at run time; measured over all shaders) ----
# c2：貼圖句柄表 0x20 + 8 r（32 槽）、分離採樣器表 0x568、圖像句柄表 0x120 + 8 r（8 槽）；translator 內置同值，不同就要先讓翻譯器可配

# c2: texture handle table 0x20 + 8 r (32 slots), separate sampler table 0x568, image handle table 0x120 + 8 r (8 slots); the translator has the same values built in, so a game that differs needs a configurable translator first
# c0：存儲緩衝表基址（每階段 16 槽 × 0x10） | c0: storage buffer table bases (16 slots × 0x10 per stage)

# 來源組：路徑裡含前者就歸後者組（按順序取第一個；main 內嵌的固定歸 main，都不中歸 other） | source groups: a path containing the first part goes to the second group (first match wins; shaders embedded in main always go to main, no match goes to other)
# 映射表表頭裡的著色器來源說明 | description of the shader source in the map table header
